namespace Orders

structure CreateOrder where
  item : String
  deriving Repr, BEq, Lean.ToJson, Lean.FromJson

structure Created where
  orderId : String -- fresh, header
  deriving Repr, BEq, Lean.ToJson, Lean.FromJson

  deriving Repr, BEq, Lean.ToJson, Lean.FromJson

structure Order where
  orderId : String -- link

  deriving Repr, BEq, Lean.ToJson, Lean.FromJson

/-- The roles. -/
inductive Role where
  | client
  | api
  deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

/-- What an event carries: one message of the protocol, or an event a role performs alone. -/
inductive Payload where
  | createOrder (m : CreateOrder)
  | created (m : Created)
  | getOrder (m : GetOrder)
  | order (m : Order)
  deriving Repr, BEq

/-- The protocol and version this module speaks (selfhost.session.versions). -/
def protocolName : String := "Orders"
def protocolVersion : Nat := 0

/-- The versions a peer may speak to this build: its own, and the one before it while the upgrade runs. -/
def acceptedVersions : List Nat := [0]

/-- The highest version both sides accept, or none: never a guess. -/
def negotiate (theirs : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (acceptedVersions.filter theirs.contains).foldl (fun acc v => some (match acc with | some a => max a v | none => v)) none

/-- The event envelope (selfhost.session.envelope): ts in nanoseconds, unique in its stream. -/
structure Event where
  ts : Nat
  session : String
  src : Role
  dst : Role
  cause : Option Nat := none
  prev : Option Nat := none
  /-- the sender's clock when it sent and the receiver's when it received, ns (selfhost.session.timelines) -/
  sentAt : Option Nat := none
  receivedAt : Option Nat := none
  /-- the protocol and version it was sent in -/
  protocol : String := protocolName
  version : Nat := protocolVersion
  payload : Payload
  deriving Repr, BEq

/-- Whether an event is one this build may take: this protocol, in a version it accepts. -/
def admits (e : Event) : Bool := e.protocol == protocolName && acceptedVersions.contains e.version

/-! Client: its states, the typestate states of its projection. -/
namespace Client

inductive State where
  | s0
  | s1
  | s2
  | s3
  | done
  deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

def start : State := .s0

/-- The step an event takes Client from a state, where the protocol allows it. -/
def step : State -> Event -> Option State
  | .s0, { src := .client, dst := .api, payload := .createOrder _, .. } => some .s1
  | .s1, { src := .api, dst := .client, payload := .created _, .. } => some .s2
  | .s2, { src := .client, dst := .api, payload := .getOrder _, .. } => some .s3
  | .s3, { src := .api, dst := .client, payload := .order _, .. } => some .done
  | _, _ => none

/-- Whether the session may end here. -/
def final : State -> Bool
  | .done => true
  | _ => false

/-- The events Client takes part in. -/
def involves (e : Event) : Bool := e.src == .client || e.dst == .client

/-- Whether one session's events, in order, are a complete run of Client. -/
def accepts (evs : List Event) : Bool :=
  match (evs.filter involves).foldlM step start with
  | some s => final s
  | none => false

end Client
